derivation_notes: Real porous adsorbers have a finite population of sites whose progressive occupancy modulates the intrinsic adsorption rate (Langmuir/BET-like site blocking or cooperativity); tracking the surface coverage theta_occ as a lagged image of the bound pool captures this history-dependent capacity effect.
change_summary: Promoted the surface occupancy from an implicitly instantaneous, capacity-unlimited assumption to an explicit dynamical state theta_occ that modulates the adsorption rate, relaxing the assumption that the intrinsic uptake rate is independent of how many sites are already filled.

assumption_audit.parent_reduction: In the limit alpha_theta -> 0 the coverage no longer modulates uptake and the C and S_ads equations recover the parent system exactly, regardless of theta_occ dynamics.
